# Models that Squadron agents can be switched to with a
# `directive:use-model-<model>-cost-<tier>` issue label.
#
# One model per line: <Copilot CLI model id> <cost tier>. The Squadron Setup workflow creates
# one label per line and deletes `directive:use-model-*` labels that are no longer listed.
# Agents ignore model labels that are not listed here.
#
# Only models included in the Copilot Pro plan are listed. Cost tiers follow GitHub's
# per-token price (output tokens, default tier, from GitHub's "Models and pricing" page):
#   low:    under $2 per 1M output tokens
#   medium: $2 to $8 per 1M output tokens
#   high:   over $8 per 1M output tokens
gpt-5.6-luna      low
claude-haiku-5.5  low
claude-haiku-4.5  medium
claude-sonnet-5   high
claude-sonnet-4.6 high
